instructions: For each source, open the url (or run the search when url is null or stale), then record the newest edition, revision, errata or effective date you can see with `python scripts/watchtower.py observe --source <id> --seen "<short canonical text>" --url <page actually read> --note "<one line>"`. Keep `seen` stable and terse (for example: `2025 edition; errata 2026-01-01; next cycle 2028 rulemaking open`) so unchanged pages compare equal week to week. Read only official issuer pages; do not record news or vendor summaries as `seen`.

sources.name: California Electrical Code (Title 24 Part 3) adoption and errata
